Normalize observed media URLs with an explicit HTTPS port, and prefer the actual f=save download links over player URLs returning an eleven-byte default range.
evidence: Authenticated OCSC direct download probe succeeded; ordinary GET returned Content-Length 11 with RIFF prefix. NYU authenticated account remains explicitly not authorized.
scope: Acquisition only; existing cohort/source/model/protocol files and user-stop marker unchanged.
parallel_transfer_policy: Up to eight independent TalkBank clients/transfers; single coordinator writes reports under the existing acquisition lock. Every transfer retains its original job, participant, source and cohort. LUCID remains serial.
interrupted_attempts: attempt1: rejected short player responses; attempt2: serial transfer changed to four workers; attempt3: four workers changed to eight. Matching partials preserved, completed recordings reverified and skipped.
